claim_boundary: WomenSports supplies a manually labelled broad Fencing image class for women in sport, but no weapon, athlete, event, bout, touch, or action labels. The deposited archive has 12,666 images although the later paper reports 33,504; the discrepancy is retained. The original images were collected from public websites and open-source datasets, so dataset-level CC BY does not eliminate possible third-party rights. Images remain local research inputs. Exact duplicates are excluded and perceptual groups must stay intact in any evaluation split.
dataset_license: CC BY 4.0 at the Mendeley dataset level
repository_policy: local images only; publish code, source links, hashes, counts, and aggregate audits
